note: Made by tools/build-transit.py from SFMTA's GTFS schedule feed. Do not edit by hand. Each entry is the usual weekday daytime path of one Muni line in one direction. No times are kept. Lines that only run at rush hour are left out. "under" lists the stretches of a rail line that run underground, as [first, last] positions in "line"; route type 5 is a cable car, which runs on the street.
